cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester who gave birth in a hospital in Wuhan, China, before and after the COVID-19 lockdown
finding: While the overall cesarean delivery rate didn't differ, cesarean delivery on maternal request and fetal distress were more common after lockdown, and newborns were significantly heavier.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) was significantly more common in the observation group (after lockdown) than the control group.
